name: benzonitrile_xtb_second_field_2026-11-20
purpose: TASKS 211, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-20_Anharmonic_Step_Substituted_Molecule.md, part A: a second GFN2-xTB quartic force field of benzonitrile with its GVPT2 label, by the runner the pipeline's step 6 uses (probes/xtb_field_for_step.sh: probes/xtb_anharmonic.sh, then probes/gvpt2_labels.py --setting X), started from corpus A_3100da3761's B3LYP minimum (second_minimum/G/ref.json, 0.00057 bohr rms from the pipeline run's own, start.json) instead of the pipeline's. Check 1 of the first-run checks is then read against a reference built on this field (probes/anharmonic_second_field.py reference). It is a reproducibility check between two fields at one level of theory, not an accuracy check. The dry run leaves ids.tsv and selection.json in second_field/ (probes/xtb_field_for_step.sh writes them before its dry-run branch); the real run writes both again and skips nothing for them. Nothing new is called: the same scripts as probes/runspecs/s2_xtb.json and the pipeline runs of 17 and 19 Nov

estimate.basis: the same field of the same molecule by the same scripts, 67 Hessians at 2 x 2 threads: 656 s alone on 17 Nov and 1,831 s beside the training search on 19 Nov (pipeline_benzonitrile_anharmonic_v3_2026-11-19/RESULT.md, check 4); the label 5 s

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run's process tree at 1536 MB (CAP_MB); the two pipeline runs of this field peaked at 1,007 and 1,003 MB under the same cap (17 and 19 Nov, the records' field.peak_memory_mb)
